title: Convex order, log-convexity and moments of averages of random variables
summary: We establish a convex order comparison for products of averages of exchangeable nonnegative random variables. As a consequence, we solve a conjecture of Lamkin and Tkocz (2022) on the log-convexity of moments of sample means, as well as its pointwise version, in a more general form involving arbitrary integer partitions.
